name: ListObject
description: Represents a list object in the ListObjects collection.
remarks: The ListObject object is a member of the ListObjects collection. The ListObjects collection contains all the list objects on a worksheet.
example:
Dim wrksht As Worksheet
Dim oListCol As ListRow

Set wrksht = ActiveWorkbook.Worksheets("Sheet1")
Set oListCol = wrksht.ListObjects(1).ListRows.Add

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Active
properties.description: Returns a Boolean value indicating whether a ListObject object on a worksheet is active-that is, whether the active cell is inside the range of the ListObject object. Read-only Boolean.

properties.name: DataBodyRange
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the range of values, excluding the header row, in a table. Read-only.

properties.name: DisplayRightToLeft
properties.description: True if the specified ListObject is displayed from right to left instead of from left to right. False if the object is displayed from left to right. Read-only Boolean.

properties.name: HeaderRowRange
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the range of the header row for a list. Read-only Range.

properties.name: InsertRowRange
properties.description: Returns a Range object representing the Insert row, if any, of a specified ListObject object. Read-only Range.

properties.name: ListColumns
properties.description: Returns a ListColumns collection that represents all the columns in a ListObject object. Read-only.

properties.name: ListRows
properties.description: Returns a ListRows object that represents all the rows of data in the ListObject object. Read-only.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Returns or sets a String value that represents the name of the ListObject object.

properties.name: QueryTable
properties.description: Returns the QueryTable object that provides a link for the ListObject object to the list server. Read-only.

properties.name: Range
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the range to which the specified list object in the list applies.

properties.name: ShowAutoFilter
properties.description: Returns Boolean to indicate whether the AutoFilter will be displayed. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ShowTotals
properties.description: Gets or sets a Boolean to indicate whether the Total row is visible. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: SourceType
properties.description: Returns an XlListObjectSourceType value that represents the current source of the list.

properties.name: TotalsRowRange
properties.description: Returns a Range object representing the Total row, if any, from a specified ListObject object. Read-only.

properties.name: SharePointURL
properties.description: Returns a String representing the URL of the SharePoint list for a given ListObject object. Read-only String.

properties.name: XmlMap
properties.description: Returns an XmlMap object that represents the schema map used for the specified table. Read-only.

properties.name: DisplayName
properties.description: Returns or sets the display name for the specified ListObject object. Read/write String.

properties.name: ShowHeaders
properties.description: Returns or sets if the header information should be displayed for the specified ListObject object. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: TableStyle
properties.description: Gets or sets the table style for the specified ListObject object. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: ShowTableStyleFirstColumn
properties.description: Returns or sets if the first column is formatted for the specified ListObject object. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ShowTableStyleLastColumn
properties.description: Returns or sets if the last column is displayed for the specified ListObject object. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ShowTableStyleRowStripes
properties.description: Returns or sets if the Row Stripes table style is used for the specified ListObject object. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ShowTableStyleColumnStripes
properties.description: Returns or sets if the Column Stripes table style is used for the specified ListObject object. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Comment
properties.description: Returns or sets the comment associated with the list object. Read/write String.

properties.name: AlternativeText
properties.description: Returns or sets the descriptive (alternative) text string for the specified table. Read/write.

properties.name: Summary
properties.description: Returns or sets the description associated with the alternative text string for the specified table. Read/write.

properties.name: TableObject
properties.description: Returns a TableObject object. Read-only.

properties.name: Slicers
properties.description: Returns a list of the table slicers associated with a ListObject. Read-only.

properties.name: ShowAutoFilterDropDown
properties.description: True when the AutoFilter drop-down for the ListObject object is displayed. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: AutoFilter
properties.description: Filters a table using the AutoFilter feature. Read-only.

properties.name: Sort
properties.description: Gets or sets the sort column or columns and sort order for the ListObject collection.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes the ListObject object and clears the cell data from the worksheet.

methods.name: Publish
methods.signature: Publish(Target As Variant, LinkSource As Boolean) As String
methods.description: Publishes the ListObject object to a server that is running Microsoft SharePoint Foundation.

parameters.name: Target
parameters.description: Contains an array of String values, as described in the Remarks section.

methods.name: Refresh
methods.description: Retrieves the current data and schema for the list from the server that is running Microsoft SharePoint Foundation. This method can be used only with lists that are linked to a SharePoint site. If the SharePoint site is not available, calling this method returns an error.

methods.name: Unlink
methods.description: Removes the link to a Microsoft SharePoint Foundation site from a list. Returns Nothing.

methods.name: Unlist
methods.description: Removes the list functionality from a ListObject object. After you use this method, the range of cells that made up the list will be a regular range of data.

methods.name: Resize
methods.description: The Resize method allows a ListObject object to be resized over a new range. No cells are inserted or moved.

methods.name: ExportToVisio
methods.description: Exports a ListObject object to Visio.
